title: Add context, memory, compaction, redaction, and injection regression suite

gates.name: FT-008 regression suite
gates.command: pytest backend/tests/context backend/tests/memory backend/tests/agent_harness backend/tests/integration backend/tests/security

gates.name: harness evals
gates.command: pytest backend/tests/context backend/tests/memory backend/tests/agent_harness backend/tests/integration backend/tests/security -k 'eval or injection or compaction or redaction'

verify: Regression suite covers unauthorized context/memory retrieval, revoked access, stale/superseded memory, forbidden source leakage, prompt injection, redaction failure, compaction retention, and memory non-authority.
Harness evals grade false authority, context poisoning, context overflow, budget stop, and secret leakage paths.
Evidence is sufficient for /verify and /red-verify to assess semantic correctness.
evidence_required: full FT-008 regression and eval output
coverage notes for all FT-008 acceptance criteria
VERDICT: PASS, SEMANTIC_VERDICT: semantic-pass, HUMAN_CHECKPOINT: done, ROLLBACK_RECOVERY_NOTE: present
constraints: Tests must include adversarial untrusted-content cases, not only happy paths.
Runtime/demo acceptance cannot rely on prompt-only safety assertions.
invariants: Memory/context paths cannot bypass the shared AgentHarness or context builder.
Repeated failures become tests, validators, docs, evals, or policies.
